title: Install the FaceTime HD camera driver on Intel Macs that have one
author: MrBazzieB
body:
## What

Detect the Broadcom FaceTime HD PCIe webcam (`14e4:1570`) and install `facetimehd-firmware`, `facetimehd-data`, and `facetimehd-dkms` during hardware setup. A migration covers existing installs.

This is the 720p camera in 2013–2015 Intel Macs (this machine is a MacBookPro12,1). There is no in-tree driver.

## Packaging

`facetimehd-dkms` is not in `[omarchy]` yet. Please add it to the ISO/repo from **current** [patjak/facetimehd](https://github.com/patjak/facetimehd) master (after `54fb8f2`), not AUR `0.7.0.2`.

Linux 7.2 removed `strncpy` from the kernel API. AUR `0.7.0.2` still calls it in `fthd_v4l2.c` and DKMS fails on `linux-omarchy` 7.2 with:

```
error: implicit declaration of function ‘strncpy’
```

Upstream already guards that call for kernels >= 4.2. I compiled `c5c7fac` against `7.2.5-3-omarchy` on this MacBook and it built cleanly.

Also cache `facetimehd-firmware` and `facetimehd-data` (already listed in `omarchy-other.packages`).

## Test plan

- [x] `test/shell.d/facetimehd-test.sh`
- [x] `./test/cli`
- [ ] ISO/package: `facetimehd-dkms` from current git is in `[omarchy]`
- [ ] On a Mac with `14e4:1570`, `modinfo facetimehd` and `/dev/video0` after install or `omarchy update`

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+# omarchy:summary=Detect a Broadcom FaceTime HD PCIe webcam (14e4:1570).
+
+# grep -q would SIGPIPE a chatty lspci under pipefail and look like "no camera".
+lspci -nn | grep "14e4:1570" >/dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+# Broadcom 720p FaceTime HD (PCI 14e4:1570) on 2013-2015 Intel Macs. There is
+# no in-tree driver; facetimehd is the reverse-engineered module. Linux 7.2
+# removed strncpy, so the packaged facetimehd-dkms must be built from
+# patjak/facetimehd after 54fb8f2. AUR 0.7.0.2 does not compile on linux-omarchy 7.2.
+
+if omarchy-hw-facetimehd; then
+  echo "Detected FaceTime HD camera"
+
+  omarchy-pkg-add facetimehd-firmware facetimehd-data facetimehd-dkms
+fi

@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+echo "Install the FaceTime HD camera driver on Intel Macs that have one"
+
+# Fresh installs get this from install/hardware/apple/fix-facetimehd.sh. Existing
+# Macs only pick it up on omarchy update via this migration.
+if omarchy-hw-facetimehd; then
+  source "$OMARCHY_PATH/install/hardware/apple/fix-facetimehd.sh"
+fi

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
+
+leaf="$ROOT/install/hardware/apple/fix-facetimehd.sh"
+hw="$ROOT/bin/omarchy-hw-facetimehd"
+all="$ROOT/install/hardware/all.sh"
+manual="$ROOT/manual/44-mac-support.md"
+other_packages="$ROOT/install/omarchy-other.packages"
+migration="$ROOT/migrations/1789542390.sh"
+
+grep -q 'apple/fix-facetimehd.sh' "$all" ||
+  fail "the FaceTime HD fix runs during hardware setup"
+grep -q 'omarchy-hw-facetimehd' "$leaf" ||
+  fail "the install leaf keys off the FaceTime HD detector"
+grep -q 'facetimehd-dkms' "$leaf" ||
+  fail "the install leaf installs facetimehd-dkms"
+grep -qx 'facetimehd-dkms' "$other_packages" ||
+  fail "the ISO caches facetimehd-dkms"
+grep -qx 'facetimehd-firmware' "$other_packages" ||
+  fail "the ISO caches facetimehd-firmware"
+grep -qx 'facetimehd-data' "$other_packages" ||
+  fail "the ISO caches facetimehd-data"
+grep -q '14e4:1570' "$hw" ||
+  fail "the detector matches the Broadcom 1570 PCI ID"
+grep -q 'FaceTime HD' "$manual" ||
+  fail "Mac support documents the FaceTime HD camera"
+grep -q 'fix-facetimehd.sh' "$migration" ||
+  fail "a migration applies the FaceTime HD fix on existing installs"
+pass "the FaceTime HD fix is wired into hardware setup"
+
+test_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$test_tmp"' EXIT
+
+stub_bin="$test_tmp/bin"
+calls="$test_tmp/calls.log"
+mkdir -p "$stub_bin"
+: >"$calls"
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/lspci" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+
+# Chatty like real lspci: keep writing well past the pipe buffer after the
+# match, so a grep -q consumer would kill this stub with SIGPIPE and pipefail
+# would read that as "no such hardware" (#6608).
+if (( ${FACETIMEHD_HARDWARE:-0} == 1 )); then
+  echo '02:00.0 Multimedia controller [0480]: Broadcom Inc. 720p FaceTime HD Camera [14e4:1570]'
+fi
+for _ in {1..4096}; do
+  echo '00:00.0 Host bridge [0600]: Filler Device [ffff:0000]'
+done
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-pkg-add" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+
+printf 'omarchy-pkg-add' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\t%s' "$@" >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\n' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+SH
+
+cat >"$stub_bin/sudo" <<'SH'
+#!/bin/bash
+
+printf 'sudo' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\t%s' "$@" >>"$TEST_LOG"
+printf '\n' >>"$TEST_LOG"
+"$@"
+SH
+
+install -m0755 "$hw" "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-facetimehd"
+chmod +x "$stub_bin"/*
+
+# Detector: present
+FACETIMEHD_HARDWARE=1 PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-facetimehd"
+pass "detector matches PCI 14e4:1570"
+
+# Detector: absent
+if FACETIMEHD_HARDWARE=0 PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" "$stub_bin/omarchy-hw-facetimehd"; then
+  fail "detector ignores machines without a FaceTime HD camera"
+fi
+pass "detector skips machines without a FaceTime HD camera"
+
+run_leaf() {
+  local hardware="$1"
+  : >"$calls"
+  FACETIMEHD_HARDWARE="$hardware" PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" TEST_LOG="$calls" \
+    bash -euo pipefail -c 'source "$1"' _ "$leaf"
+}
+
+run_leaf 1
+grep -Fxq $'omarchy-pkg-add\tfacetimehd-firmware\tfacetimehd-data\tfacetimehd-dkms' "$calls" ||
+  fail "leaf installs firmware, calibration data, and the DKMS module" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "leaf installs firmware, calibration data, and the DKMS module"
+
+run_leaf 0
+[[ ! -s $calls ]] || fail "non-matching hardware is a no-op" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "leaf is a no-op on machines without a FaceTime HD camera"
+
+run_migration() {
+  local hardware="$1"
+  : >"$calls"
+  FACETIMEHD_HARDWARE="$hardware" PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" TEST_LOG="$calls" \
+    OMARCHY_PATH="$ROOT" \
+    bash -euo pipefail "$migration" >/dev/null
+}
+
+run_migration 1
+grep -Fxq $'omarchy-pkg-add\tfacetimehd-firmware\tfacetimehd-data\tfacetimehd-dkms' "$calls" ||
+  fail "the migration installs the FaceTime HD packages" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "the migration installs the FaceTime HD packages"
+
+run_migration 0
+[[ ! -s $calls ]] || fail "the migration is a no-op without a FaceTime HD camera" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "the migration is a no-op without a FaceTime HD camera"

comments.body:
Confirmed working on another supported Intel Mac, with one packaging update that may simplify this PR.

Test system:

- MacBookAir6,2
- Broadcom FaceTime HD Camera `14e4:1570`
- Omarchy 4.0.4-1
- `linux-omarchy` 7.2.5-3

Installed and tested:

- `facetimehd-dkms` 0.7.2-1
- `facetimehd-firmware` 1:1.43_5-2
- `facetimehd-data` 5.1.5769-2

DKMS built successfully for `7.2.5-3-omarchy`, `modprobe facetimehd` initialized the ISP and created `/dev/video0`, and V4L2 identified it as `Apple Facetime HD`. A fresh capture completed 30/30 frames at 1280x720 YUYV and 29.97 fps. Installing `facetimehd-data` also supplied the requested `1871_01XX.dat` calibration file, removing the missing-calibration warning.

The PR body's warning about stable AUR `0.7.0.2` appears to be stale now: the current stable package is 0.7.2-1 and compiles cleanly against Omarchy's 7.2.5 kernel. That may remove the need to package a separate current-master build in `[omarchy]`.

Strong support for the PCI-ID-gated install and migration. The exact package set proposed here works on MacBookAir6,2 and produces real 720p video, not just a loaded module.
